trailhead.label: below the pilgrimage church in Maria Luggau, the board’s start

cautions: About 300 m on the Gailtalstraße (B111) through Maria Luggau, signed 50 km/h: keep your dog close on a short lead.
The Gail runs fast beside the path: keep your dog out of the water.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
